name: adr-writing
description: Write Architecture Decision Records. Supports Michael Nygard format (Title / Status / Context / Decision / Consequences) and Y-statement format (In the context of X, facing Y, we decided Z, achieving A, accepting B). Per ADR: stable ID, status (proposed / accepted / deprecated / superseded), supersession chain, index/log. Review cadence + integration with traceability-matrix. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
